review_scope: Artifact and methodology review of the completed canonical finite-input verification. Bulk Monte Carlo raw rows are not self-contained in the proposed prompt; no claim of new full raw-row recomputation by the external reviewer.
required_conditions: All three matching attempt2 operations are RECORDED
Completion retention is RETAINED and all report/completion hashes verify
Actual source hashes match the exact reviewed 19-source mapping
All 51 locked input bindings remain unchanged
All included artifacts have exact path, byte count and SHA256
Negative, incomplete and unresolved statuses are preserved
No narrative, previous review verdict or test verdict appears in the reviewer-facing artifacts
grounded_data: The exact current deterministic manifest and all its channels/metrics/oracle output bytes
Exact current manifest inventory and selected-output hashes from completed reports
Executable conditional recipes and their manifest/channel bindings from completed lineage
explicit_exclusions: Author mathematical certificates and uncertainty census
Previous source-review findings, responses and recommendations
Historical attempt1 and intermediate launch/checkpoint narratives
Raw authenticated transport, credentials and account metadata
findings.md, to_human reports and provenance summaries
bulk_data_limit: Monte Carlo channels and wide metrics remain local manifest-bound artifacts. Any review item requiring unseen bulk data must be marked not_reviewed or inconclusive. A read-only packet review is not a new simulation or a full independent raw-row recomputation.
packet_size_policy: Record actual full artifact size; never silently omit a required artifact. If the packet exceeds the receiving session capacity, partition it with an explicit scope and completeness manifest before seeking transfer authorization.
required_review_fields: Artifact-specific locations and quoted numeric evidence
Prediction-by-prediction verdicts with scope and declared tolerances
Coverage, common draws, fairness, constraints, uncertainty, precision and claim-lineage checklist
Findings: severity, location, evidence, consequence, proposed fix or check
No PI gate decision; inconclusive is not PASS
